dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: It's amazing! This whole island... is actually a gift?

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: ...Honorary Knight, I—I can't help but feel a little emotional. Of course, it wasn't my gift... but I just feel so moved by it all.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: When people spend a long time together, they become... more important to each other.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: *sigh* ...A good reminder. In fact, many things have become clearer to me now.
